text:
support_anna: FYI customer 'acme-health' just opened an escalation. They have EU residency pinned but we see requests routed to us-west-2. High P99 latency reported and billing spike. Audit alerts fired (RESIDENCY_VIOLATION). Pls triage :rotating_light:

sanjay_eng: @support_anna can you paste a request ID + sample headers? Also which model and plan?

support_anna: request id: r-0f3b2c9e, user-account: acme-health-eu, model: redwood/gpt-8-small, plan: dedicated-eu (customer says dedicated commit). Headers we got:

```
x-region-preference: eu-central-1
x-account-id: acme-health-eu
authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>
```

compliance-bot: ALERT: RESIDENCY_VIOLATION detected
- account: acme-health-eu
- routed_region: us-west-2
- event_ts: 1987654319
- policy: residency_pin_enforced (exception reported)

oncall_infra: grabbing router logs now. Quick check: did the EU pool report full capacity or a health event? :eyes:

ops_bot: Autoscaler: scale_up attempt failed in eu-central-1 due to GPU quota error (quota_exceeded). Fallback policy active: allow_cross_region_fallback = true

sanjay_eng: OK that explains routing. Fallback kicked in because autoscaler failed. BUT why did compliance-bot mark it as a policy exception? We should only fallback for non-pinned customers.

support_anna: customer insists they were pinned and paid for reserved capacity. They got charged hosted rates for the burst in us-west. Finance flagged a billing delta.

finance_jeff: tagging — billing shows token usage billed at hosted_us_west_rate for request r-0f3b2c9e. Need audit logs to justify credit or reversal.

marta_legal: This is a compliance exposure. If EU residency was violated for regulated data, we need timeline + all audit entries. Also confirm whether KV cache or responses left EU boundary.

sanjay_eng: Repro steps I ran locally to mimic:
1) Simulate eu commit pool at capacity and force autoscaler quota_exceeded.
2) Send request with header `x-region-preference: eu-central-1` and account flagged pinned.
3) Router evaluated policy -> fallback_to: us-west-2 because allow_cross_region_fallback=true and no strict residency enforcement for dedicated commit in config.

Command I used to fetch router decision:```
curl -s -H "X-Request-Id: r-0f3b2c9e" "https://internal-router-redwood/api/v1/decision?req=r-0f3b2c9e" | jq .
```

oncall_infra: From logs:
```
1987654318 | req=r-0f3b2c9e | account=acme-health-eu | pool=dedicated-eu | pool_state=quota_exceeded | fallback_allowed=true | selected_region=us-west-2
```

sanjay_eng: Root cause: config drift. Some dedicated pools have fallback_allowed toggled on; pin enforcement logic only checked at admission, not at fallback decision. We'll need a patch to make fallback check residency pin before selecting remote region.

support_anna: Customer asking for mitigation now — recommended next steps?

sanjay_eng: Immediate mitigation options:
- Disable cross-region fallback for pinned/residency-enforced accounts (hotfix to router config) — low risk, immediate.
- Roll back fallback flag on dedicated-eu pool (requires infra review).
- Issue temporary credit for billed hosted tokens and notify compliance/legal.

marta_legal: Please prepare audit bundle (router logs, autoscaler events, billing charge id) and DM me. We'll craft a disclosure if data residency was breached.

finance_jeff: I'll queue a billing hold on acme-health-eu and mark for manual review.

compliance-bot: ATTACH: /audit/residency/acme-health-eu/1987654319/logs.tar.gz

sanjay_eng: I'll open a PR with a guard: at fallback decision time, if account.residency_pin == true -> deny_cross_region_fallback. Target: patch + deploy to canary within 2 hrs.

support_anna: I'll tell the customer we're investigating, pausing cross-region fallback for their account now, and will escalate billing. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

oncall_infra: Action items assigned:
- oncall_infra: apply temporary router config override for acme-health-eu (done)
- sanjay_eng: PR + tests for fallback-residency-guard (in progress)
- finance_jeff: billing hold + refund eval
- marta_legal: prepare compliance remediation comms
- support_anna: customer comms + follow-up

sanjay_eng: Follow-up note: we'll add a unit test and an e2e that simulates autoscaler quota_exceeded to ensure we don't bypass residency for any pinned account.

support_anna: closing loop here once PR is merged and refund confirmed. Timestamps attached in compliance bundle.
